Within minutes, silence turns to dread, and dread turns to terror, as she realizes she is not alone in her own house. Trapped and hunted through the dark, she must outwit two violent predators who will stop at nothing.
rentals:10:1822624.title: Deadbolt

rentals:10:1823264.overview: Filmed at The Den Theater in Chicago, Gareth Reynolds (We’re Here to Help, The Dollop) delivers a fast, funny hour about life in an increasingly automated America. From the robo-takeover of everyday life and the strange demands of an algorithm-driven culture to the healing power of animals and the uphill battle of making a living in modern entertainment, Reynolds finds the absurdity in a world that feels less human by the day. He also turns his attention to America’s billionaires, arguing that they are not only wildly powerful and deeply troubling, but embarrassingly lame. Building from sharp observations into a lively musical finale, the special brings its biggest ideas together in a closing number that is equal parts ridiculous, pointed, and unexpectedly catchy, suggesting that the antidote to all of this is the healing power of animals.
rentals:10:1823264.title: Gareth Reynolds: Why Aren't You Bigger?
